\section*{Chapter 33 - SDKs \& Clients}


\subsection*{Purpose}

This chapter provides reference documentation for AIM-OS SDKs and client libraries enabling developers to integrate AIM-OS capabilities into their applications. SDKs provide high-level abstractions over AIM-OS APIs.

\subsection*{Executive Summary}

\item AIM-OS provides SDKs for Python, TypeScript, and PowerShell enabling easy integration.
\item Client libraries abstract API complexity and provide type-safe interfaces.
\item SDKs enable rapid development of AIM-OS-integrated applications.

\subsection*{Python SDK}

\textbf{Installation:}
``\texttt{bash
pip install aimos-sdk
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Usage:}
}`\texttt{python
from aimos import AIMOSClient

\section*{Initialize client}
client = AIMOSClient(api\_url="http://localhost:5001")

\section*{Store memory}
memory\_id = client.store\_memory(
    content="AIM-OS enables AI consciousness",
    tags=["consciousness", "ai"],
    metadata={"source": "chapter\_expansion"}
)

\section*{Retrieve memory}
memories = client.retrieve\_memory(
    query="AI consciousness",
    limit=10,
    filters={"tags": ["consciousness"]}
)

\section*{Track confidence}
witness\_id = client.track\_confidence(
    task="chapter\_expansion",
    confidence=0.90,
    evidence=["tier\_a\_sources", "quality\_gates\_passing"]
)

\section*{Create plan}
plan\_id = client.create\_plan(
    goal="Expand chapter on AIM-OS",
    context={"chapter": "ch33\_sdks\_clients"},
    priority="high"
)

\section*{Get memory stats}
stats = client.get\_memory\_stats(include\_breakdown=True)
print(f"Total atoms: {stats['total\_atoms']}")
print(f"Total snapshots: {stats['total\_snapshots']}")
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Features:}
\item Type-safe interfaces with Pydantic models
\item Automatic error handling and retries
\item Async/await support (planned)
\item Comprehensive documentation

\subsection*{TypeScript SDK}

\textbf{Installation:}
}`\texttt{bash
npm install @aimos/sdk
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Usage:}
}`\texttt{typescript
import { AIMOSClient } from '@aimos/sdk';

// Initialize client
const client = new AIMOSClient({
  apiUrl: 'http://localhost:5001'
});

// Store memory
const memoryId = await client.storeMemory({
  content: 'AIM-OS enables AI consciousness',
  tags: ['consciousness', 'ai'],
  metadata: { source: 'chapter\_expansion' }
});

// Retrieve memory
const memories = await client.retrieveMemory({
  query: 'AI consciousness',
  limit: 10,
  filters: { tags: ['consciousness'] }
});

// Track confidence
const witnessId = await client.trackConfidence({
  task: 'chapter\_expansion',
  confidence: 0.90,
  evidence: ['tier\_a\_sources', 'quality\_gates\_passing']
});

// Create plan
const planId = await client.createPlan({
  goal: 'Expand chapter on AIM-OS',
  context: { chapter: 'ch33\_sdks\_clients' },
  priority: 'high'
});

// Get memory stats
const stats = await client.getMemoryStats({ includeBreakdown: true });
console.log(}Total atoms: \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_0\_\_{stats.totalSnapshots}\texttt{);
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Features:}
\item TypeScript type definitions
\item Promise-based async API
\item Error handling with typed errors
\item Tree-shakeable exports

\subsection*{PowerShell SDK}

\textbf{Installation:}
}`\texttt{powershell
Install-Module -Name AIMOS -Scope CurrentUser
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Usage:}
}`\texttt{powershell
\section*{Import AIM-OS module}
Import-Module AIMOS

\section*{Initialize client}
\_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_1\_\_memoryId = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_2\_\_memories = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_3\_\_witnessId = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_4\_\_planId = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_5\_\_stats = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_6\_\_(\_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_7\_\_(\_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_8\_\_{chapterId}\texttt{,
    confidence: 0.90,
    evidence: ['tier\_a\_sources']
  });
  
  // Perform expansion
  const result = await performExpansion(chapterId);
  
  // Store expansion results
  await client.storeMemory({
    content: result,
    tags: ['chapter\_expansion', chapterId]
  });
  
  return result;
}
}`\texttt{

\subsubsection*{PowerShell Integration Example}

\textbf{Use Case:} Integrate AIM-OS into PowerShell scripts for automation

}`\texttt{powershell
\section*{Import AIM-OS module}
Import-Module AIMOS

\section*{Initialize client}
\_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_9\_\_UserQuery)
    
    \# Retrieve relevant context
    \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_10\_\_client | Retrieve-Memory }
        -Query \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_11\_\_response = Generate-Response -Query \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_12\_\_context
    
    \# Store response in memory
    \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_13\_\_response \texttt{
        -Tags @("response", "user\_query") }
        -Metadata @{ query = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_14\_\_response
}

\section*{Track confidence for operations}
function Expand-Chapter {
    param([string]\_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_15\_\_client | Track-Confidence \texttt{
        -Task "expand\_\_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_16\_\_result = Perform-Expansion -ChapterId \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_17\_\_client | Store-Memory }
        -Content \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_18\_\_ChapterId)
    
    return \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_19\_\_{error.message}\texttt{);
    // Handle error
  }
}
}`\texttt{

\textbf{PowerShell:}
}`\texttt{powershell
try {
    \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_20\_\_client | Store-Memory -Content "..."
} catch {
    Write-Error "Error: \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_21\_\_\_.Exception.Message)"
    \# Handle error
}
}`\texttt{

\subsubsection*{Configuration}

\textbf{Python:}
}`\texttt{python
client = AIMOSClient(
    api\_url="http://localhost:5001",
    timeout=30,
    retry\_count=3
)
}`\texttt{

\textbf{TypeScript:}
}`\texttt{typescript
const client = new AIMOSClient({
  apiUrl: 'http://localhost:5001',
  timeout: 30000,
  retryCount: 3
});
}`\texttt{

\textbf{PowerShell:}
}`\texttt{powershell
$client = New-AIMOSClient }
    -ApiUrl "http://localhost:5001" \texttt{
    -Timeout 30 }
    -RetryCount 3
```
